scope.interpretation_summary: The trucking market encompasses the transportation of goods via road using trucks, involving various participants such as distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners.
scope.market_definition: The trucking market encompasses the transportation of goods via road using trucks, involving various participants such as distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners. This market operates globally, facilitating logistics and supply chain management across diverse industries.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of trucking services and products through various intermediaries.
This layer includes companies that resell trucking services and products to end-users.
This layer consists of companies that integrate trucking solutions into broader logistics systems.
This layer includes service providers that offer support and maintenance for trucking operations.
This layer involves various channel partners that collaborate with trucking companies to enhance service delivery.
